description: The error half of replace-supplied-id, and the reason supplying an _id is worth it. The filter is a typo away from the intended one — it means document 7 but matches document 8 — so the _id in the replacement disagrees with what the filter found. That is refused: nothing is written, and BOTH documents come back untouched below, still carrying the email field the replacement does not have. Without the _id there would be nothing to disagree with, and document 8 would silently become Emma Rivera.

mutations.error: the filter matched document "8", but the replacement carries _id "7"
